# Code of Conduct

This project adopts the **Contributor Covenant v2.1** as its code of conduct. The full text is maintained upstream at:

<https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/>

## Scope

The Covenant applies in all routess project spaces: this repository, its issue tracker, pull requests, discussions, and any public space where someone represents the project.

## Reporting

To report unacceptable behaviour, contact **robbe@settlemint.com**.

All reports are reviewed promptly and treated confidentially. Project maintainers are obligated to respect the privacy and security of the reporter of any incident.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers follow the [Enforcement Guidelines](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines) published with the Covenant when deciding the consequences of a violation.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1, available at <https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html>.
